runners_data.name: Custers Mistake
runners_data.note: Lightly raced nine-year-old returning from a 401-day absence for Peter McCreery; running style entirely unknown from available data, making this a significant risk on first run back in over a year.
runners_data.comment: Custers Mistake won last time out and has run over today's trip and going, with our rating of 108 marking him out as a leading threat in a field of 19; the sole concern is a layoff of over 400 days.

runners_data.name: Leave In Secret
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner for Thomas Gibney, sound on Good ground with six places from eight similar-ground runs but no win in current form string; faces stiff pace competition from Mo Ghille Mar and Claude which could compromise his ability to control tempo.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts but Leave In Secret has been knocking on the door, finishing second last time out and third two starts back, and he arrives here fresh on 34 days' rest, with experience of today's trip and going, carrying 166 lb for a race in which our figures rate him very narrowly off the top.

runners_data.name: Farrokh
runners_data.note: Barry Connell's seven-year-old ran only 14 days ago and has solid form on Good ground including a recent win over 16f; sits just off the lead naturally and will want to track the pace battle from second or third without getting dragged into it.
runners_data.comment: Farrokh landed a win two starts back but has since unseated and finished fourth, so his form is mixed; he has run over today's trip and going, and 14 days between runs suggests he arrives fresh, though 162 lb is a stiff ask.

runners_data.name: Le Diablo
runners_data.note: The Strand Scorecard's top selection at low confidence; John Patrick Ryan's five-year-old is a hold-up horse with strong trainer strike rate over 14 days (2/14) and goes well fresh (11 days), but must navigate 19 runners from off the pace — confidence capped by traffic risk in a field this large.

runners_data.name: Phoenix Arizona
runners_data.note: Seven-year-old prominent racer with four places from nine similar-ground starts but no wins; consistent without threatening, and the prominent congestion makes getting a clean run early difficult for John Cullen's charge.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last six starts and ranked 14 of 19 on our figures, Phoenix Arizona is hard to fancy despite carrying 149 lb, though a second and a third in recent starts show he can hit the frame, and he has run over today's distance and going before.

runners_data.name: Claude
runners_data.note: Second confirmed front-runner for Sarah Joanna Connell; five-year-old wearing tongue-tie and blinkers, but has only one place from seven similar-ground outings and faces stronger pace rivals in Mo Ghille Mar — likely to get swallowed up if the pace becomes brutal.
runners_data.comment: Ranked top of the field on ratings and returning on a good 29-day freshener, Claude has experience of today's trip and going and shaped with promise when third three starts back; yet to win in recent starts is the concern.

runners_data.name: Stoneyford Lady
runners_data.note: Henry de Bromhead's seven-year-old wears tongue-strap and cheekpieces and has strong recent form with four places from eight similar-ground starts including a win; prominent style suits a pace scenario where she can track at cruise speed and pounce at the second-last.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last five starts, Stoneyford Lady at least showed some promise with a third two runs back, though a fourth last time out and a weight of 156 lb make progress hard to find; she has run over today's trip and going, which offers some grounding.

runners_data.name: Roccabaker
runners_data.note: Midfield runner returning from 145 days off for David Harry Kelly; has won over heavy ground and stays well, but his best form has come over longer trips and the layoff is a notable concern in a competitive 19-runner field.
runners_data.comment: Ranked 18 of 19 on our figures, Roccabaker makes this look a tough ask, and 145 days off the track adds further doubt; she has run over today's distance and going, and a win in her last five starts shows she can find the line first.

runners_data.name: Sayitfirst
runners_data.note: Ten-year-old hold-up horse for Darren Collins with a legitimate profile here — three places from seven similar-ground runs and consistent finishing speed; age is the caveat but he has run well fresh (32 days) and the pace-collapse scenario suits him directly.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last five starts and ranked 11 of 19 here, Sayitfirst carries 154 lb against her, though she has run over today's distance and going before and returns after a 32-day break with something to prove.

runners_data.name: Political Stance
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse for C Byrnes with limited similar-ground evidence (two runs, no wins or places); apprentice-ridden and lightly exposed on this going, though second from three runs on comparable conditions keeps a small interest alive.
runners_data.comment: Political Stance has been in grim form of late — unplaced and pulled up in his two most recent outings — and rated 15th of 19 on our figures, he is hard to fancy under 146 lb; a second three starts back and experience over today's trip and going are slim consolations for a gelding yet to win in his last five starts.

runners_data.name: Bossing It
runners_data.note: Josh Williamson partners this David O'Brien six-year-old who has one place from eight similar-ground starts; natural hold-up profile suits a pace-collapse scenario but needs significant improvement on current form to be competitive.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last five starts, Bossing It does at least bring distance and going experience to the table, and 26 days between runs suggests she arrives fresh; however, a 150 lb burden and a ranking of 13 of 19 in the field make a big run hard to call.

runners_data.name: Ballybrittas
runners_data.note: P J Rothwell's seven-year-old midfield runner carries 160lbs and has won and placed over this trip range on Good ground; trainer has had one winner from 26 runs over 14 days which tempers enthusiasm, but the form profile is solid enough for place claims.
runners_data.comment: Third last time out after winning two starts back, Ballybrittas has experience of today's trip and conditions, but a 160 lb burden and a trainer firing at just 4% in the last fortnight are real negatives against him here.

runners_data.name: Mo Ghille Mar
runners_data.note: Top-rated at OR=110 and a confirmed front-runner who won 14 days ago over this trip for John Joseph Hanlon; youth and fitness are strengths, but three-way pace battle risks burning him out before the straight — he wins only if he can settle the tempo quickly.
runners_data.comment: Won last time out and has previous experience over today's trip and going, but her rating of 106 ranks her fifth of nineteen and a weight of 166 lb is a stiff burden to overcome.

runners_data.name: Lady Doyanne
runners_data.note: De Bromhead's six-year-old is a Strand danger wearing tongue-tie, with three places from seven similar-ground starts; naturally prominent, she will benefit from the chaos ahead if she can sit just off the scrimmage and deliver a clean late run.
runners_data.comment: Consistently placed in recent starts, Lady Doyanne has run over today's trip and going before and arrives 34 days fresh, giving her every chance to go one better; the concern is she remains yet to win in her last five starts.

runners_data.name: Fedneys Park
runners_data.note: De Bromhead's third runner, off 89 days and with a string of double-figure finishes in recent form; tongue-tie worn but no wins from seven similar-ground runs makes it hard to see a path to victory in this competitive field.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last five starts and ranked 16 of 19 on our figures, Fedneys Park faces a stiff ask here, though she has run over today's trip before and a return from 89 days off can occasionally spark improvement.

runners_data.name: Feet On The Ground
runners_data.note: Eight-year-old hold-up horse for James William Hannon wearing hood, unraced 66 days; has two places from ten similar-ground starts and a note about fading finishes, which is a real concern in a race guaranteed to test stamina hard.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last five starts and ranked 17 of 19 on our figures, Feet On The Ground faces a stiff task here; she has run over today's trip and going, and a third three starts back offers a crumb of comfort, but 66 days off and 142 lb make her hard to fancy.

runners_data.name: Poppycon
runners_data.note: Eoin Doyle's six-year-old wears tongue-tie and cheekpieces and has three places from eight similar-ground outings; prominent runner whose consistency is reasonable, but the fall (F) in recent form and no wins on similar ground limits confidence.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts, Poppycon does offer some encouragement — a second two starts back and another second five starts back — though an unplaced last outing and 151 lb to carry are stiff tasks, despite having experience over today's trip and going.

runners_data.name: Coole Vision
runners_data.note: Norman Lee's nine-year-old is the lowest-rated runner in the field at OR=75 with only two similar-ground runs and no wins or places; prominent by style but faces a very steep task against 18 rivals in better form.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last four starts and ranked bottom of the field on our figures, Coole Vision faces a stiff task here; two pulled-up or unplaced efforts among his most recent runs are hard to dismiss, though he has run over today's trip and going before and returns after a 52-day break.

runners_data.name: Itsalonglongroad
runners_data.note: Twelve-year-old for David O'Sullivan who wears a hood and is flagged as a horse who fades in the finish; that trait is a serious liability in a strong-pace stamina test over 2m1f, making this a difficult betting proposition regardless of prominent intentions.
runners_data.comment: Itsalonglongroad has run over today's trip and going before and shaped with promise when third last time out, but he remains winless in his last five starts and a hefty 146 lb is a significant burden to overcome here.

races.paceDynamic: Mo Ghille Mar, Leave In Secret, and Claude form a genuine three-way battle for the lead, guaranteeing a strong gallop across Ballinrobe's 2m1f on Good to Yielding ground — this is not a race where the front will coast. Eight of the 19 runners want prominent positions, meaning the first two fences will see significant jostling and traffic congestion is near-certain from 2-3 out as that pack compresses. The relentless pace set by three confirmed front-runners on softening ground will drain stamina reserves early, exposing those who expend energy getting position and rewarding horses that can settle off the pace and pick up late. This race shape squarely favours hold-up and late-finishing profiles — horses like Le Diablo, Sayitfirst, and Bossing It who can track the carnage from midfield and close through beaten horses in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse, Closers Land
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners burn each other out before 3 out, leaving the field strung out and spent.
scenarios.body: The relentless early gallop strips stamina from the lead pack, and Good to Yielding ground compounds the attrition as the race enters its final mile; hold-up horses who have tracked off the pace find clear runs as the leaders fade.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Capitalises
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent types settles just off the lead battle and pounces at the second-last.
scenarios.body: A horse sitting third or fourth early absorbs the pressure without burning out completely, then quickens with a clear run when the front-runners tie up; the field's prominent congestion means one horse will inevitably get the dream trip at the right moment.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Mo Ghille Mar establishes a sustainable lead early and one rival drops away, easing the pace battle.
scenarios.body: Mo Ghille Mar, a five-year-old with strong recent form including a win 14 days ago, could use youth and fitness to sustain the gallop if Leave In Secret or Claude fail to match strides past halfway; a genuinely dominant front-runner who controls the tempo can steal a decisive break jumping the last.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Midfield Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses spectacularly late and a hold-up horse produces a powerful wide run from well off the bridle.
scenarios.body: A mass blow-up in the lead group creating a clear outer path for a horse who has conserved energy throughout; this is the least likely shape because it requires both a full pace collapse AND a clean passage through 19 runners, but the field size keeps it live.

watchPoints.text: Mo Ghille Mar, Leave In Secret, and Claude — watch the first two fences closely; if all three lock horns immediately at the head of affairs, the pace will be brutal and any of them cramping or falling could cause a chain-reaction incident through the prominent pack.

Traffic congestion risk 2-3 out is acute with eight horses chasing prominent positions — Le Diablo and Sayitfirst, both hold-up horses needing clear runs, are most vulnerable to getting pocketed if the field bunches at the second-last fence.

Stoneyford Lady and Lady Doyanne both run for Henry de Bromhead in the same race; watch which of the two gets the cleaner passage at 3 out, as team tactics could see one sacrifice ground to assist the other.
Custers Mistake returns from 401 days off with unknown style data — any erratic jumping or traffic violation early from this horse could create chaos through the prominent pack at a crucial stage.

Le Diablo's low confidence flag from the Strand Scorecard is consistent with a hold-up horse facing a 19-runner field with guaranteed traffic; watch his position entering the back straight for signs his jockey is already locked in without a clear run.
